sentences: GIVA has raised over $100 million in a funding round led by Multiples Alternate Asset Management and co-investors to expand its retail network, strengthen manufacturing and scale its omnichannel operations.
Fine jewellery brand GIVA has raised over $100 million in a funding round led by Multiples Alternate Asset Management , along with its co-investors.
The investment will help the company expand its retail network, strengthen manufacturing capabilities and scale its omnichannel presence.
The company plans to expand its retail network to over 1,000 outlets in the next three to five years, according to a press release.
GIVA currently operates more than 400 stores across India and Sri Lanka, with a presence in Tier-I and Tier-II markets.
GIVA offers jewellery across sterling silver, gold and lab-grown diamonds .
The company operates through its own retail stores, direct-to-consumer (D2C) website and third-party e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms.
GIVA also raised $28 million in debt in May this year.
Entrackr exclusively reported the development, which could be part of the current funding round.
The company said it grew at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of over 70% in the past three years, ending FY26 with revenue of around Rs 865 crore.
It plans to use the fresh capital to strengthen its leadership team, expand manufacturing capabilities and increase its offline presence.

GIVA has raised over $258 million to date, including Rs 110 crore (around $12 million) in a Series C extension round led by HPV CC1 Ltd in February this year.
While the company is yet to file its FY26 financial statements, its operating revenue grew 89% year-on-year to Rs 518 crore in FY25.
Its losses increased 22% to Rs 72 crore during the same period.

GIVA competes with organised jewellery players such as BlueStone, CaratLane , Melorra, Candere and Tanishq, along with newer brands including Palmonas, Jewelbox, Limelight Lab Grown Diamonds, Fiona Diamonds and Firefly Diamonds.
